register: # SOURCE: KOSTAL Interface description MODBUS (TCP) & SunSpec, revision 2.7 (valid from PIKO/PLENTICORE G1 UI 01.30.12092, G2 SW 02.15, G3 and MP G3 SW 3.06). Section 4.2 lists the implemented models: 1, 103, 113, 120, 123, 160, 203, 802 and the end model. Model 203 (meter) is valid from PLENTICORE G2 SW 02.12, G3 SW 3.04.01 and MP G3 SW 3.05.00.

# CONNECTION: Modbus TCP on port 1502 (not 502), unit ID 71 by default. Enable Modbus under Settings > Modbus/SunSpec (TCP) and set the byte order there to big-endian (ABCD) Sunspec. The interface description gives little-endian (CDAB) Standard Modbus as the default, and SunSpec data is big-endian.

# NOT VERIFIED: these rows use the standard SunSpec layouts of the implemented models and have not been checked against a Kostal inverter. Float model 113 is the float counterpart of model 103 and is not mapped; Kostal's own (non-SunSpec) register table is also not covered here.

# DYNAMIC MAP: rows whose register column is [anchor+offset] are template rows. The anchors come from the SunSpec model chain the device reports (discovery in the protocol JSON) and fall back to the discovery_defaults in that JSON, so the map is complete before a device has been read. {i} repeats a row once per instance found (MPPT modules, meters). See documentation/architecture/dynamic_register_discovery.md.
